title: solutions-pro-services-weekly-sync-notes-2026-05-19
agenda: Quick updates from each customer engagement
Rollout and cutover windows for next week
summary: Weekly sync for Solutions Engineering + Professional Services focused on customer integration status, infra readiness, and risks. Meeting captured in informal notes; follow-ups assigned below.
customer_updates: Acme Retail - GA rollout planned for 2026-05-27. Integration testing passed for 90% of test cases; remaining issues are related to session stickiness when routing between dedicated and hosted fallbacks. Connor to own a mitigation plan with infra by 5/21.

FinBank - Private deployment (VPC) in staging: DB access policy caused onboarding failure. Security requested extra audit logs; engineering provided temporary allowlist on 5/18. ETA for full remediation is 5/22 after KMS config change. Customer-run smoke tests scheduled 5/23.

HealthCo - Embeddings pipeline integration is delayed due to tokenization mismatch in upstream ETL. Solutions team delivered patch v0.3.2 to HealthCo on 5/18; customer will validate on 5/20. Note: PHI handling checks are being tracked with security and legal.

EdgeStart (pilot) - Early production traffic started 5/15; observed higher-than-expected latency spikes during peak for sequence lengths >1024. Ethan to run sampling of kernel selection logs and provide a short report by 5/21. Consider temporary forced-quantization profile for pilot if report suggests kernel thrash.
blockers: Session stickiness issue for Acme Retail when failover triggers between dedicated pool and hosted fallback (could lead to inconsistent KV cache). Blocker impact: high for GA. Owner: Connor. Next step: infra run forced failover test and capture traces (5/21).
KMS policy propagation delay for FinBank private deployment prevents rotation and full NIST compliance signoff. Owner: Priya + Security. Escalation to infra if not fixed by 5/22.

Tokenization mismatch causing embedding drift for HealthCo. Owner: Solutions Eng (Aisha) and HealthCo data team. Short-term workaround: re-tokenize historical corpus with new tokenizer; long-term: align tokenizers in ETL (ETA 6/03).
risks: If Acme stickiness not resolved before GA, customer may experience session-level hallucination/regression due to stale KV cache - reputational risk.
FinBank compliance delay could push go-live by 2+ weeks if audit artifacts aren't produced on time.
EdgeStart latency spikes may increase cost if forced autoscaling is needed; recommend capacity cap in dedicated pool while root cause is investigated.
decisions: Approve canary window for Acme GA on 2026-05-27 with 5% traffic for first 4 hours; rollback criteria defined (error rate >1% or median p95 latency increase >30%).
Allow temporary allowlist for FinBank KMS during staging validation with strict expiration (5/25) and audit logging enabled.
Run forced-quantization profile on EdgeStart for 48 hours to evaluate latency improvement; require infra report before expanding.
action_items: Connor: Create mitigation runbook for Acme session stickiness and schedule failover test with infra by 2026-05-21.
Ethan: Collect kernel selection and latency traces for EdgeStart and share report in thread (expected 2026-05-21).
Priya: Coordinate KMS policy fix with Security and FinBank SRE, confirm propagation by 2026-05-22.
Aisha: Work with HealthCo data team to validate embedding patch and confirm results by 2026-05-20.
Mariana: Update customer-facing risk register and notify CSMs of canary plan for Acme by EOD 2026-05-19.
notes: Observed intermittent 503s for Acme were correlated with autoscaler bounce during a configuration change; infra recommends minor cooldown adjustments.
Security flagged additional logging requirements for PHI pipelines; action created in CONFLUENCE-INTG-21.
Remind customers to run the provided post-deploy smoke test checklist (link posted in Slack #cs-integration).
raw_text: Notes (informal): - quick call, a lot of follow-ups. Acme is main GA risk; FinBank needs KMS; HealthCo embeddings look promising after patch. Connor to lead on Acme. Ethan to deep-dive EdgeStart kernel logs. Priya loop in security for KMS. Mariana will notify CSMs.
